images.caption:
Name : Arabic Calligraphy Enggraving
Material : Copper
Estimate : Ca 16 - 17 Century
Origin : Mataram Islamic Period
Description :
Serves as a place of water decorated with mythological animals, a dragon and calligraphy writing which means: 1 Alif Lam Mim, We really have become strong / strong. We believe in our Prophet.
Berfungsi sebagai tempat air yang di hiasi dengan binatang mitologi seekor naga dan tulisan kaligrafi yang bermakna :
1 Alif Lam Mim, Sungguh kami menjadi teguh / kuat. Kami beriman kepada Nabi kami.

2 Dengan asma Allah Yang Maha Pengasih lagi Maha  Penyayang. Tiada daya dan kekuatan kecuali dengan Allah Yang Maha Luhur dan Maha Agung

images.filename: Clothes and Head Band with Rajah Decoration.jpg
images.caption:
Name : Clothes and Head Band with Rajah Decoration
Material : Cloth and Gold Ink
Estimate : Ca 18 -19 Century
Origin : Mataram Islamic Period
Description : 
Berajah vests and headbands are believed to give strength and immunity to the wearer, which is commonly used by fighters and warriors in Java in fighting against the invaders.

Rompi dan Ikat Kepala Berajah dipercaya memberikan kekuatan dan kekebalan kepada pemakainya yang biasa di pakai oleh para pesilat dan Jawara di tanah Jawa dalam melawan penjajah.

images.caption:
Name : Javanesse Baking Pan Cooking
Material : Copper
Estimate : Ca 17 - 18th Century
Origin : Mataram Islamic Period
Description : 
The tool for printing apem cakes used by the Keraton family in Java, is at the ceremony to welcome fasting and the Prophet's Birthday.

Alat untuk mencetak kue apem yang di pakai keluarga Keraton di Jawa, ada saat upacara menyambut puasa dan Maulid Nabi.

images.filename: Vorst Mangkoe Rat II doorsteekt met zijn kris, genaamd "de eerwaarde Blabor", den opstandeling Troenadjaja.jpg
images.caption: Amangkurat II executed Trunajaya (leader of Trunajaya rebellion), watched by his two wives, Kliting Koening and Kliting Woengoe, and two VOC officers, Jacob Couper and Kapitein Jonker, and the others. This event happened in 1680.
images.alt: Amangkurat II executed Trunajaya (leader of Trunajaya rebellion), watched by his two wives, Kliting Koening and Kliting Woengoe, and two VOC officers, Jacob Couper and Kapitein Jonker, and the others. This event happened in 1680.

images.filename: Soenan Mas verlustigt zich in de aanschouwing der door hem bevolen straffen en wreedheden, 1703.jpg
images.caption: Amangkurat III ordered the death penalty for Raden Ayu Lembah (his wife) and Raden Sukra (son of an official who had an affair with Raden Ayu Lembah) in 1703, while Raden Sotjo Koesomo, who tried to rebel, was imprisoned in a cage and exhibited in alun-alun. It is said that Pakubuwono I was forced to punish his daughter (Raden Ayu Lembah was the daughter of Pakubuwono I and married to Amangkurat III) by Amangkurat III himself, as depicted in the painting.
images.alt: Amangkurat III ordered the death penalty for Raden Ayu Lembah (his wife) and Raden Sukra (son of an official who had an affair with Raden Ayu Lembah) in 1703, while Raden Sotjo Koesomo, who tried to rebel, was imprisoned in a cage and exhibited in alun-alun.
